## Study goals

- Understand how noncompliance is represented as partially observed compliance status.
- Understand the definition and estimation of site-speific complier average causal effects.
- Understand the bivariate hierarchical generalized random-coefficients model.
- Understand the shared random-effects structure.
- Understand maximum likelihood estimation using adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature.
